import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde
import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.PullbackFree
import MilneLib.Sheaf.OverSheaf

/-!
# Quasicoherence under open restriction

Local presentations restrict along open immersions. We transport the
presentations between the over-site and the open subscheme, then apply
quasicoherence locality on the inverse-image cover.

Adapted from the slice-presentation proof in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotScheme` for Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace Topology

namespace MilneLib

private noncomputable def overRestrictEquiv {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) ≌ U.toScheme.Modules :=
  letI eqv := Opens.overEquivalence U
  (SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence
      (J := (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X).over U) (K := Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥U) eqv
    (S := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (ObjectProperty.homMk
      (Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.op eqv.unitIso.inv) (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (𝟙 _))
    (by ext : 2
        simp only [Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app,
          NatTrans.op_app, NatTrans.id_app, ObjectProperty.homMk_hom, NatTrans.comp_app]
        exact congrArg (Sheaf.over X.ringCatSheaf U).obj.map
          (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Equivalence.unitInv_app_inverse eqv _).symm))
    (by ext : 2
        simp only [Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app,
          NatTrans.op_app, ObjectProperty.homMk_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.id_app]
        erw [Category.id_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
        rename_i x
        have h : (eqv.unitIso.inv.app (Opposite.unop x)).op ≫
            (eqv.unit.app (Opposite.unop x)).op = 𝟙 _ := by
          rw [← op_comp]
          simp only [CategoryTheory.Equivalence.unit, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, op_id]
        exact (congrArg (Sheaf.over X.ringCatSheaf U).obj.map h).trans
          (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _))).symm

private noncomputable def overRestrictFunctorIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) :
    (SheafOfModules.pushforward (S := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (𝟙 _)) ⋙
        (overRestrictEquiv U).functor ≅ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι :=
  haveI : ((Opens.overEquivalence U).inverse ⋙ Over.forget U).IsContinuous
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥U) (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X) :=
    Functor.isContinuous_comp (Opens.overEquivalence U).inverse (Over.forget U)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥U) ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X).over U)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X)
  SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp _ _ ≪≫ SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (by cat_disch)

private noncomputable def overRestrictPullbackIso {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : X.Opens) (M : X.Modules) :
    (overRestrictEquiv U).functor.obj (M.over U) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj M :=
  (overRestrictFunctorIso U).app M ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app M

private theorem isIso_unitToPushforwardObjUnit_of_isIso
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {D : Type u} [Category.{u} D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D} {Fu : C ⥤ D}
    {S : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}} {R : Sheaf K RingCat.{u}} [Fu.IsContinuous J K]
    (ψ : S ⟶ (Fu.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} J K).obj R)
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ RingCat.{u} AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    [K.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ RingCat.{u} AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (hψ : IsIso ψ) : IsIso (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit ψ) := by
  haveI := hψ
  haveI hmap : IsIso ((sheafToPresheaf J RingCat).map ψ) := inferInstance
  rw [NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app] at hmap
  rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _)]
  rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (sheafToPresheaf _ _)]
  rw [NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro V
  haveI hiso : IsIso (ψ.hom.app V) := hmap V
  haveI : IsIso ((forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat).map (ψ.hom.app V)) := inferInstance
  exact this

private noncomputable def overRestrictUnitIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) :
    (overRestrictEquiv U).functor.obj (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf := by
  unfold overRestrictEquiv
  refine (@asIso _ _ _ _ (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      (F := (Opens.overEquivalence U).inverse) (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥U)
      (S := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (𝟙 _)))
    (isIso_unitToPushforwardObjUnit_of_isIso _ ?_)).symm
  exact inferInstanceAs (IsIso (𝟙 U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf))

private noncomputable def overRestrictPresentation {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : X.Opens) (M : X.Modules) (P : (M.over U).Presentation) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj M).Presentation :=
  SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u} (overRestrictPullbackIso U M).hom
    (SheafOfModules.Presentation.map.{u} P (overRestrictEquiv U).functor
      (overRestrictUnitIso U))

private noncomputable def overRestrictUnitIsoInv {X : Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Opens) :
    (overRestrictEquiv V).inverse.obj (SheafOfModules.unit V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) :=
  (overRestrictEquiv V).inverse.mapIso (overRestrictUnitIso V).symm ≪≫
    (overRestrictEquiv V).unitIso.symm.app _

private noncomputable def overRestrictPresentationInv {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (V : X.Opens) (M : X.Modules)
    (P : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj M).Presentation) : (M.over V).Presentation :=
  SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u}
    ((overRestrictEquiv V).unitIso.symm.app (M.over V)).hom
    (SheafOfModules.Presentation.map.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u} (overRestrictPullbackIso V M).inv P)
      (overRestrictEquiv V).inverse (overRestrictUnitIsoInv V).symm)

private noncomputable def pullbackOpenImmersionUnitIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] :
    (SheafOfModules.pullback f.toRingCatSheafHom).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf := by
  haveI hopen : IsOpenMap f.base := f.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap
  haveI : (Opens.map f.base).Final :=
    haveI : (Opens.map f.base).IsRightAdjoint := hopen.adjunction.isRightAdjoint
    inferInstance
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingCatSheafHom).IsRightAdjoint := inferInstance
  exact asIso (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom)

private noncomputable def pullbackPreimageIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.resLE U (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj M) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.Opens.ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (f.resLE U (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl) U.ι).app M ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
      (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι f (U := U) (V := f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl)).app M ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Scheme.Opens.ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) f).app M).symm

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
-- Presentation transport expands the over-site equivalence and its sheaf maps.
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
private noncomputable def presentationPullbackPreimage {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : X.Modules) (q : M.QuasicoherentData) (i : q.I) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.Opens.ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)).Presentation :=
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (f.resLE (q.X i) (f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)) le_rfl) := by
    delta Scheme.Hom.resLE
    infer_instance
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u, u, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.resLE (q.X i) (f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)) le_rfl)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _).leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u}
    (pullbackPreimageIso f M (q.X i)).hom
    (SheafOfModules.Presentation.map.{u}
      (overRestrictPresentation (q.X i) M (q.presentation i))
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.resLE (q.X i) (f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)) le_rfl))
      (pullbackOpenImmersionUnitIso (f.resLE (q.X i) (f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)) le_rfl)).symm)

private theorem quasicoherent_coversTop_preimage {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (M : X.Modules) (q : M.QuasicoherentData) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥Y).CoversTop (fun i => f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)) := by
  intro W y hy
  obtain ⟨U, _, hsieve, hyU⟩ := q.coversTop ⊤ (f.base y) (by trivial)
  rw [Sieve.mem_ofObjects_iff] at hsieve
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨hUi⟩⟩ := hsieve
  refine ⟨W ⊓ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (q.X i)), homOfLE inf_le_left, ?_, hy, ?_⟩
  · rw [Sieve.mem_ofObjects_iff]
    exact ⟨i, ⟨homOfLE inf_le_right⟩⟩
  · change f.base y ∈ q.X i
    exact leOfHom hUi hyU

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
-- The cover-locality proof elaborates several nested slice-site presentations.
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- Pullback along an open immersion preserves quasicoherence. -/
theorem isQuasicoherent_pullback_of_isOpenImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent := by
  obtain ⟨q⟩ : Nonempty M.QuasicoherentData :=
    SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.nonempty_quasicoherentData
  let qs := q.shrink
  haveI : ∀ i, (((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M).over
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ (qs.X i))).IsQuasicoherent := fun i =>
    (overRestrictPresentationInv (f ⁻¹ᵁ (qs.X i)) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
      (presentationPullbackPreimage f M qs i)).isQuasicoherent
  exact SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
    (fun i => f ⁻¹ᵁ (qs.X i)) (quasicoherent_coversTop_preimage f M qs)

/-- Native restriction along an open immersion preserves quasicoherence. -/
theorem isQuasicoherent_restrict_of_isOpenImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (M.restrict f).IsQuasicoherent :=
  (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app M).symm
    (isQuasicoherent_pullback_of_isOpenImmersion f M)

end MilneLib
